description: Takes a website domain, reads the imprint to find the legal entity (DACH sites), then runs the KYB check on it: grade A to F, ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK, reasons, sanctions, VAT and domain security. Use to vet a counterparty from its website. Needs an imprint on the site (Germany, Austria, Switzerland); otherwise errors with Not charged, then use kyb-check with the company name. Price: $0.06 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"domain":"sap.com"}.
